payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precomputes factorials and inverses, then computes sum_{i=d}^{n} C(n,i)*2*(i-d) mod M, multiplies by k/2^n, where d=n-m.
payload.rationale: Solution uses binomial coefficient summation over all possible number of additions by Bob, derived from DP analysis. No iterative DP table; instead closed-form combinatorial counting. Fits dp_counting_combinatorics best.
